paragraphs: He reported in the name of R' Elazar, Bikkurim, chapter 2, halakhah 2. Seder HaDorot cites this form; our reading is bar Acha.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ס״הד is read contextually as Seder HaDorot; the heading figure is the natural understood reporter despite not being renamed in the sentence.

בכורים פ״ב ה״ב explicitly giveschapter 2 halakhah 2, suggesting Jerusalem Talmud without a stated corpus or independently checked named edition. Bar-Chama is the cited form and bar-Acha Hyman’s our-text reading; no name correction or identity merge is made. Both personal title abbreviations remain R'.
